title: AegisIAM Autonomous Agent Identity Provisioning Request
description: JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) validating POST /v1/agents/identities request payloads for autonomous AI agent identity and RBAC provisioning.

agent_name.description: Unique lowercase alphanumeric slug identifying the autonomous agent within the tenant.

orchestrator_type.description: Underlying AI agent orchestration framework or runtime.

sponsor_identity_id.description: Immutable directory ID of the MFA-verified human sponsor accountable for the agent.

rbac_policies.description: Explicit least-privilege RBAC policy URNs bound to the agent identity.

allowed_mcp_tools.description: Optional allowlist of Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool identifiers.

token_ttl_seconds.description: Ephemeral OAuth 2.0 workload access token lifetime in seconds (5 to 60 minutes).

mtls_fingerprint_sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 hex fingerprint binding the agent token to a client mTLS certificate.

audit_webhook_url.description: Optional HTTPS webhook endpoint for real-time token exchange and invocation telemetry.
